Global accumulated reward index (1e18 precision) driving claimable TAD.
Mapping of user address to staked TEN balance.
Aggregate TEN staked across all holders.

Per-user cumulative claimed TAD.
Aggregate TAD claimed by all users.

Internal unstaking logic: claims TAD, returns TEN and updates stakes.
Refreshes miningStateIndex/miningStateBlock via getMiningState.
Pure view computing new reward index and block from totalStaked and tadPerBlock.
External claim entrypoint that updates state then transfers TAD to msg.sender.
View computing pending TAD for an address from index delta and stake.

edges.reason: msg.sender flows into stake as the staking account used by createStake.
msg.sender selects the stake holders balance in unstake.
msg.sender determines the claimable TAD recipient in claimTad.
msg.sender is passed as _address into createStake.
msg.sender is passed as _address into withdrawStake.
msg.sender supplies msg.data consumed by the proxy fallback.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender to equal admin before changing implementation.
_setAdmin requires msg.sender to equal admin before changing admin.
Proxy constructor sets admin and _owner directly from msg.sender.
stake delegates staking logic to createStake.
unstake delegates withdrawal logic to withdrawStake.
createStake invokes claimTad before recording the new stake.
withdrawStake invokes claimTad before returning the stake.
claimTad refreshes the mining index via updateMiningState.
withdrawStake refreshes the mining index via updateMiningState.
updateMiningState computes new values through getMiningState.
claimTad queries claimableTad to determine the payout.
claimableTad reads miningStateIndex to compute the index delta.
claimableTad reads stakeHolders for the user balance.
claimableTad reads stakerIndexes for the last user index.
claimableTad checks totalStaked for first-staker initialization.
claimTad writes stakerIndexes to the current miningStateIndex.
claimTad accumulates the payout into stakerClaimed.
claimTad accumulates the payout into totalClaimed.
claimTad uses TadToken to pay the reward.
createStake uses TenToken to pull the stake.
withdrawStake uses TenToken to return the stake.
createStake increases stakeHolders[_address].
createStake increases totalStaked.
withdrawStake decreases stakeHolders[_address].
withdrawStake decreases totalStaked.
getMiningState reads and returns miningStateIndex.
getMiningState reads and returns miningStateBlock.
getMiningState divides accrued TAD by totalStaked.
getMiningState multiplies delta blocks by tadPerBlock.
updateMiningState assigns the new miningStateBlock returned by getMiningState.
initiate sets initiated to true as a one-time guard.
initiate sets startMiningBlockNum.
initiate computes endMiningBlockNum as start plus totalGenesisBlockNum.
initiate sets tadPerBlock.
initiate stores the TAD token address.
initiate stores the TEN token address.
initiate resets miningStateBlock to the start block.
createStake performs the external TenToken.transferFrom call.
withdrawStake performs the external TenToken.transfer call.
claimTad performs the external TadToken.transfer payout call.
sendTad performs the external TadToken.transfer call.
fallback forwards arbitrary calldata to delegatecall on the implementation.
TenToken.transferFrom may reenter the staking logic before state finalization.
TenToken.transfer returns control to a potentially malicious token contract.
TadToken.transfer may reenter claimTad and re-trigger reward accounting.
TadToken.transfer in sendTad may call back into the contract.
delegatecall transfers execution to the implementation which may call back.
pause sets the _paused flag through _pause.
unpause clears the _paused flag through _unpause.
sendTad uses TadToken for the emergency transfer.
_setImplementation overwrites the implementation address.
_setImplementation authorizes via comparison against admin.
_setAdmin overwrites the admin address.
Proxy constructor initializes admin from msg.sender.
Proxy constructor initializes _owner from msg.sender.
Proxy constructor records the initial implementation address.
fallback reads implementation and delegatecalls into it.
Caller-scoped TEN transfers rely on msg.sender allowances via TenToken.
stake passes its _amount argument toward createStake.
unstake may substitute the full stakeHolders balance when _amount is zero.
claimableTad local drives the transfer amount in claimTad.
blockNumber local caps the block used in the index math.

TEN token address parameter validated and stored by initiate.
Internal parameter determining whose stake is recorded.
Amount parameter directly used in the TEN transferFrom call.
Internal parameter determining which stake balance is reduced.
Amount parameter bounds the TEN transfer performed on withdrawal.
External user-supplied stake amount entering the public entrypoint.
External user-supplied unstake amount, zero meaning full withdrawal.
Block argument that bounds the reward-index computation.
Recipient parameter of the emergency TAD transfer.
Amount parameter of the emergency TAD transfer.
Upgrade target parameter validated before assignment.
New admin parameter written into admin storage.
Local computed reward amount used directly as the transfer value.
Local snapshot of the index used only to compute the delta.
Local capped block value used solely inside the state computation.
